title: Unstable SMP Simulator
description: All of the Minecraft Simulators (Unstable, Bliss, Manhunt etc) you'll ever need with new Sims automatically updated without needing to change the modpack
body:
### If u want any Sims added or find a bug about the modpack pls submit it [here](https://forms.gle/mqZ9E9gNRSc311ES9) ### I don't add paid maps!! --- Modpack Latest Update (YYYY-MM-DD) **Vexbot: *2026-10-21*** **Carpet: *2026-10-21*** --- ![Unstable SMP: The LAW](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5900f25dd38ff46d1e2cde098e1847c735414c4e.jpeg) *Image from [Wemmbu](https://youtu.be/f_aRA-KcTQs)* --- [![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?labelColor=black&color=grey&label=&suffix=%20downloads&query=downloads&url=https://api.modrinth.com/v2/project/zHP6LZ7W&style=flat&logo=data:image/png;base64,)](https://modrinth.com/modpack/theunstablesmpsimulator) ## 📦 About I made this modpack for players to install minecraft Unstable Simulator **more easily** — without the tedious process of installing maps, selecting mods, and configuring everything manually. **All the necessary mods for PvP are pre-installed with *Auto Updating Simulators*.** > ~~Check out my ***[Mod Version](https://modrinth.com/mod/import-sims)*** of Unstable Simulators~~ "Under Review" --- ## 🔀 Version Differences | Version | Simulator Type | |---------|----------------| | `1.21.11-x` | **Carpet**-based simulators | | `Vex-1.21.11-x` | **Vexbot**-based simulators | --- ## Vexbot Simulators (Vex-1.21.11-x) > From **Vex-1.21.11-7.x** maps will not be included in the Modpack. > > Instead there will be a button **Import Simulators** at the world select screen. > > It might take a while due to the maps total sizes (few Gigabytes), so if U don't have time or whatever you can just use Vex-1.21.11-6.2 instead > > Note: Vex-1.21.11-6.x will not be updated due to Modrinth Max File Limit (~500MB) > > So please **Press Import Simulators at the world select screen** > > Also you DON'T need to update the modpack to get the new simulators just repress the **Import Simulators** and **Import Kits** button since ***Vex-1.21.11-7.3***
Maps (Vex-1.21.11-7.x ~ ) - Bat vs Itzrealeme - ***Remastered FlameFrags Simulator v2.1*** - ***Definitive FlameFrags vs Wemmbu Simulator*** - Invis Island Eggchan Bid Fight - Invis assassin simulator - Jadenman Vs Wemmbu Simulator - JamatoP VS SpokeIsHere Simulator - Lakerek VS Wemmbu Simulator - Law End Island Defense Simulator - Law HQ fight - ***Law Prison Breakout-v1.4*** - ***ManePear's training simulator*** - Miniute Vs Null - Mist Simulator - Null Fight Simulator - Ocean rangers simulator - Purgatory Finale Fight Simulator-v1.2 - Purgatory Vs Spokeishere Iron - ***Shoebilly vs wemmbu simulator*** - Spoke VS Leow0ok - The Council Simulator v1 - The Director simulator - Theo vs Shoebilly simulator - UNSTABLE SMP KITS - Underworld simulator - Underworld simulator Remastered - Unstable Battle on HighWater free version 1.0v - ***Unstable SMP Tournament*** - ***WemmbuVSFlame*** - kingdom_of_the_caves - smuggler path law fight - warden vs wemmbu - zam invasion simulator - Wemmbu vs Arachn1d simulator - Hunger Games - Wemmbu vs Boosfer Crew Simulator v1 - Theo vs oroboros V1.0 - ***Mugm vs The Horizon Simulator*** (Pls read README.txt in the map folder) - Farex PULL!!! - Highwater sim Rework - Wemmbu vs Chungies - Flame vs Clown - FlameFrags vs Toxic players Simulator - Wemmbu vs Null Wraiths - Wemmbu vs underground civ - INVIS BLUE GUY SIMULATOR - UnstableSMP VS WispSMP - Slushly VS Stormz - Slushly VS Nufuli - Wemmbu Vs Flowtives - Optimized farlands fight - Jaden_MAN vs Wemmbu - I mastered mace combat simulator - **WILLOW PVP PRACTICE MAP** - Nitenly Tortuing Simulator - **Singleplayer PvP V2.1 Fix** - Quantum's PvP Practice v1.18 - Theobald's PVP Practice 1.4 - Bounty Hunter Fight SImulator v1 - Heartless Horizon Vikings Fight Simulator v1 - Mugm vs Naparizel Bliss SMP Fight Simulator v1 - Dol9hin Assassin Simulator v1 - Assasin Simulator V1.2 - The Wraith Simulator ***bold*** = goated
